name: Open World
author: htubdawg
description: Free roam in a 32 km (20 mile) square of country generated from a fixed seed the way real country comes about: rivers that drain the land to the sea, a market town, villages and farms where people would settle, and a road network grown in order of importance, from a trunk road down to farm tracks, with organic town streets, bridges and fields. Built in the Tokyo scene; the weather is drawn each race. A floating origin keeps the physics precise anywhere. Works in Multiplayer rooms with the Multiplayer mod as it is.
